==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/tɒm/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/tɑm/|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-tom.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɒm|s=1}}

===Etymology 1===
{{etymon|en|id=name|Tom<id:name>|tree=1}}
From generic use of the proper name {{m|en|Tom}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# The male of the [[domesticated]] [[cat]], especially if not [[neutered]].
# The male of the [[turkey]].
# The male of the [[orangutan]].
# The male of certain other animals.
# {{lb|en|UK|slang|dated}} A [[female]] [[prostitute]].
# {{lb|en|US|slang}} A [[lesbian]].
# {{lb|en|music}} {{clipping of|en|tom-tom}}.
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} The [[jack]] of [[trump]]s in the [[card game]] [[gleek]]. <!--Webster 1913-->
# {{lb|en|UK|regional|obsolete}} A [[close-stool]].

=====Synonyms=====
* {{s|male cat}} {{l|en|tomcat}}, {{l|en|he-cat}}
* {{s|male turkey}} {{l|en|turkey-cock}}
* {{s|male of other animals}} {{l|en|male}}, {{l|en|buck}}, {{l|en|stag}}
* {{s|prostitute}} See also [[Thesaurus:prostitute]]

===Etymology 2===
Shortened from {{m|en|tomato}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|British|greengrocers'|_|slang}} A [[tomato]] {{qualifier|the fruit}}.
#: '''''Toms''' 90p a pound''
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2009|author=Mark Penny; Jonathan Penny|title=The Golden Pig|page=160
|passage=“I'd like sausage, eggs, bacon, '''toms''', mushies, beans – oh, and some fried bread,” said Mike.}}

===Etymology 3===
Rhyming slang from {{m|en|tomfoolery}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun|-}}

# {{lb|en|Cockney rhyming slang}} [[jewellery]]

===Etymology 4===
From {{m|en|Uncle Tom}}.

====Verb====
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|intransitive|derogatory|of a black person}} To act in an obsequiously servile manner toward white authority.

===Etymology 5===

====Verb====
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|nautical}} To dig out a [[hole]] below the [[hatch]] [[cover]] of a [[bulker]] and fill it with [[cargo]] or [[weight]]s to aid [[stability]].
